name: karigor
description: Karigor: AI-based platform to find the right home technician in Dhaka

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
